candidate_windows.window_text: We employ BERT (Devlin et al., 2019) as the encoder of our entity selector and attribute selector and employ T5 (Raffel et al., 2020) to implement the response generator. All these models are fine-tuned using AdamW optimizer (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2018) with a batch size of 64. We train these models for $15\mathrm{k}$ gradient steps with a linear decay learning rate of $10^{-4}$ . We conduct all experiments on a single 24G NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU and select the best checkpoint based on model performance on the validation set.
